note: The High pnpm cache path into `release/release` was judged false: the only job that writes the restored key is the release job itself in the default-branch scope, and pull_request runs write their own merge-ref scope, so there is no second writer, trusted or not (`ci.yml` runs setup-node without a cache). The write default is recorded from the effect the assessment saw: its release workflow pushes with the default token and succeeds. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
